component_structure.title_screen: Opening title screen with Japanese title (因果 / 選ぶと、), sound toggle, start/continue
component_structure.narrative_viewport: First person scene view with layered backgrounds, fog overlay, dynamic ambient lighting
component_structure.choice_system: Branching decision options styled as Japanese wooden tags or ink stamps
component_structure.emaki_scroll: Unrolling horizontal scroll (emaki) at bottom showing narrative progress (Peaceful -> Strange -> Unsettling -> Distorted -> Horrifying)
component_structure.journal_modal: Foldable notebook panel with clues, yokai entries, sumi-e sketches, symbol log
component_structure.audio_engine: Procedural Web Audio API soundscape with low drones, wind whispers, temple bells, heartbeats
component_structure.gemini_banana_integration: AI image art generator interface for custom scroll art expansion and scene variants
component_structure.ending_gallery: Multiple narrative endings screen with sumi-e seal unlocks

instructions_to_main_agent: Include font link in index.html for 'Shippori Mincho' and 'Yuji Syuku'.
Use data-testid on all interactive buttons, choices, journal tabs, and scroll controls.
Ensure UI maintains washi parchment paper texture background rather than flat digital black or white.
Implement Web Audio API synth for procedural horror drones and wind noise.
Maintain LocalStorage persistence for game state and unlocked journal entries.
Integrate Gemini Nano Banana API trigger option for generating visual scroll variations.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT center-align main app text container globally.
Avoid generic blue gradients or default Vercel design aesthetics.
Use generous spacing p-6 to p-12 around containers.
Ensure every interactive element has a responsive hover and active state with explicit text colors.
Always provide data-testid attributes for testing.
